item.title: Pick up with Murph on a new channel
item.summary: Connect email or phone and Murph greets you there, using your conversation context once you have started chatting.
item.details: Before your first message, each connected channel gets the welcome. Later connections get a brief greeting without restarting onboarding. Setup retries avoid duplicate outreach, email connections can recover a failed save, and contact buttons show the right next step. Your text number remains available when outbound welcome capacity is full.
